extension.description: Decodes LAE (Layered Audio Extension) files: LAES (lossless) in WAV, RF64 and FLAC containers, LAEY (lossy) in WAV and FLAC containers. Masters are verified by SHA-256 on first playback.[CR][CR]Note: Kodi passes only files with the extension .lae to this add-on. LAE files named .wav or .flac are played by Kodi's built-in decoder, which outputs only the core master (LAES) or the CD/core layer (LAEY). Rename such files to .lae to play their masters and extension layers.

解码 LAE（分层音频扩展）文件：LAES（无损，WAV、RF64、FLAC 封装）和 LAEY（有损，WAV、FLAC 封装）。母带在首次播放时经 SHA-256 校验。[CR][CR]注意：Kodi 只把扩展名为 .lae 的文件交给本插件。扩展名为 .wav 或 .flac 的 LAE 文件由 Kodi 自带的解码器播放，只输出核心母带（LAES）或 CD 层/核心层（LAEY）。将此类文件改名为 .lae，才能播放其中的母带和扩展层。
